name: Alisa Stein
source:
The protagonist. The middle daughter of the founder of Pogranichnoye.

Introverted and a little eccentric, she has preferred her own fantasies to the real world since childhood. Alisa spends much of her time thinking about freedom, individuality, and a person’s right to remain true to themselves — and gradually turning these reflections into her own philosophy.
translation:
The protagonist. The middle daughter of the founder of Pogranichnoye.

Introverted and a little eccentric, she has preferred her own fantasies to the real world since childhood. Alisa spends much of her time thinking about freedom, individuality, and a person’s right to remain true to themselves — and gradually turning these reflections into her own philosophy.
